title: Loose pieces
intro: A piece nobody defends is a target. Learn to spot loose pieces, both yours and your opponent's, and pieces with nowhere to go.

lessons.title: Is it defended?
lessons.summary: Count who guards each piece before you move.

steps.text: Look at Black's rook on d8. Who guards it? Not the king, not the queen. It is loose, and White's rook stares at it down the d-file.
Take the loose rook. After the queen blocks the check, take that too.
steps.ifWrong: The rook on d8 has no defender: take it.
steps.ifRight: One loose rook cost Black the game.

steps.text: Black's queen on f3 just captured. Is it safe there?
steps.hint: Your queen on g2 is attacked, but it can also take something.
steps.ifWrong: The black queen is loose: take it.
steps.ifRight: The queen was loose. Rxg1+ is only a desperate try.

lessons.title: Trapped pieces
lessons.summary: A piece with no safe square can be won.

steps.text: Black's knight on g5 has very few squares. A pawn push can attack it and leave it nowhere to go.

steps.hint: Attack it with a pawn. Check every square it could run to.
steps.ifWrong: Push a pawn so the knight is attacked and every escape square is covered.
steps.ifRight: f4 attacked the knight, and all of its squares were covered: it was lost.

steps.text: Black's bishop on a8 is stuck behind your pawns. Make sure it never gets out.
steps.hint: A pawn push offers the bishop a pawn, and then the other pawn promotes.
steps.ifWrong: Push the b-pawn: if the bishop takes, the a-pawn recaptures and runs.
steps.ifRight: The bishop had to give itself up, and the b-pawn will queen.

lessons.title: Loose pieces near the king
lessons.summary: An undefended piece next to the king can mean mate.

steps.text: Black's rook on f8 is the only guard of the back rank, and White's rook on f6 attacks it. Taking it is not just a win of material.

steps.hint: The rook on f8 is defended by nothing.
steps.ifWrong: Capture the loose rook on f8.
steps.ifRight: Checkmate: the loose rook was holding the back rank.

steps.text: Black's queen on e8 guards the king, but is anything guarding it?
steps.ifWrong: The black queen is loose: take it.
steps.ifRight: Mate. A loose queen next to the king lost at once.
